hero.role: Software development student at Epitech Nancy
hero.tagline: I'm looking for a one-year work-study position in software development, in Lorraine or Bas-Rhin (France). Looking for a passionate dev? You're in the right place.
hero.aboutText: I'm 20 and I've been hooked on computers since I was 7. It all started with Minecraft: tuning software to make it run better on my PC made me want to understand what was going on inside the machine. After a detour through hardware, I came back to my first love: writing code.

project.organized.title: Organized
project.organized.text: A whole factory… inside a linked list. Organized simulates a production line where each step of the assembly line is a node in the list.
project.wolf3d.title: Wolf3D
project.wolf3d.text: Back to 1992. A Wolfenstein 3D clone in C with CSFML, powered by a homemade raycasting engine, coded as a team, to create the illusion of 3D.
project.arcade.title: Arcade
project.arcade.text: A modular arcade machine in C++. Snake and Minesweeper on the menu, plus three graphics libraries (ncurses, SDL2, raylib) you can swap mid-game without interrupting it.
project.raytracer.title: Raytracer
project.raytracer.text: Light, math and a lot of rays. This CPU ray tracing engine turns a scene described in a plain text file into a photorealistic image, casting one ray per pixel.
project.raytracer.li1: Spheres, planes, cones and other primitives
project.raytracer.li2: Ambient and directional lighting, ambient occlusion
project.zappy.title: Zappy
project.zappy.text: A toroidal map (exit right, come back left), rare resources and several teams competing in real time. Goal: level up at least 6 players to the max.
project.echoingvoid.title: Echoing Void
project.echoingvoid.text: Minecraft Dungeons' "Echoing Void" DLC, ported to Minecraft Java with Fabric. The End gets a new biome, creatures, endgame progression and legendary items, without touching the base gameplay.
project.echoingvoid.li1: "Void Islands" biome and its parkour challenges
project.echoingvoid.li4: Legendary weapons and an exclusive enchantment

project.mycms.title: MyCMS
project.mycms.text: Edit a website's text without touching the code. MyCMS is a local CMS for static sites hosted on GitHub Pages: edit, check, publish in one click, and it handles the HTML and Git. This web-based v2 follows the v1 I built during my driving school internship.
project.mycms.li2: Checks links, images, emails and phone numbers before publishing
project.mycms.li3: Faithful saving: only the changes are rewritten
project.mycms.li4: Windows installer (.msi) with bundled Git and automatic updates
project.lmagent.title: LMAgent
project.lmagent.text: A local AI agent (LM Studio + Qwen3.5 9B) that automates the search for a work-study position, built as a duo with Ethan Wiss. It writes applications and follow-ups and saves them as drafts in Outlook or Gmail: nothing is ever sent automatically.
project.lmagent.li2: Applications and follow-ups written as drafts
project.lmagent.li3: Application tracking in an Excel spreadsheet
project.lmagent.li4: Secure local web interface and 500+ tests
